Paul Gosar calls for action on elections and border security in recent posts
Rep. Paul Gosar, DDS, a U.S. Congressman representing Arizona’s 9th district since 2011, used his social media platform in early August 2026 to address election security, veterans’ care, and border enforcement.
On August 3, Gosar criticized the Senate for its legislative priorities regarding election integrity: "The Senate has time for endless political theater but can't find time to protect the ballot box? No recess until the SAVE Act is passed. Secure our elections!"
Later that day, he focused on veterans’ affairs, stating, "America's veterans kept their promise to this country. The VA must keep its promise to them and ensure our heroes receive the care they've earned."
On August 5, Gosar referenced migration issues at Ceuta—an autonomous Spanish city in North Africa—as a warning for U.S. border policy: "Ceuta isn't just Europe's problem, it's America's warning. Open borders don't stay 'manageable.' They become humanitarian disasters and national security failures. Finish the wall, deport illegals, enforce the law. @RepBoebert @RepMaryMiller"
Paul Gosar has maintained his seat in Congress through several election cycles; he defeated Quacy Smith in 2024 with over 65% of the vote and Richard Grayson in 2022 with nearly 98%. Born in Rock Springs, Wyoming in 1958 and currently residing in Bullhead City, Gosar holds a BS from Creighton University (1981). He succeeded Ann Kirkpatrick as representative of Arizona’s 9th district.
